product_one_liner.value: Funnel connects, cleans, models, and activates marketing data for marketing and data teams, enabling reporting, measurement, and AI workflows.
product_one_liner.notes: Company homepage and Data Hub page describe the product and use cases.

pricing_page.notes: The site links to a dedicated Pricing page; a pricing page qualifies even if details require further page interaction.

named_customers.notes: These company names are identified in Funnel customer case studies.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists 201–500 employees; Funnel’s own careers site says 300+.

hq_location.notes: Funnel identifies Stockholm as its headquarters.

founded_year.notes: Funnel states it was founded in 2014.

eng_blog.notes: The blog is a marketing-oriented publication. Although it includes data-related articles, the accessible index does not establish two engineering-authored posts focused on how Funnel's product is built.

public_docs.notes: Public Help Center contains multiple product guides and documentation collections.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: A live Product Engineer - AI Product Experience posting was listed.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed available AI/help documentation, security overview, and privacy information; none names an AI model or model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: Funnel expressly states its security program is ISO 27001 certified and that it has undergone a SOC 2 Type 2 attestation. GDPR/CCPA are stated as compliance claims, not certifications.

last_funding.notes: Funnel announced $66 million in primary capital in October 2021.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest located funding announcement was in October 2021, outside the 18-month period before 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current jobs list was readable; it included no SDR, BDR, sales development representative, or account executive title.

launched_6mo.notes: Funnel's November 2026 release notes were listed before the run date and fall within the six-month window; the existence of a current dated release-notes entry indicates a launch/release in the interval, though the page result did not expose individual feature details.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The accessible company/about and people pages do not provide dated executive join/leave information sufficient to determine changes during the period.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable integrations source pages expose marketing platform connectors but do not name CRM/sales systems as visibly used by Funnel itself; no job posting or docs evidence established its internal CRM/marketing stack.
